# Bronzla

Bronzla is a free iOS app for safe sun exposure and tanning, built for the Turkish and wider
Mediterranean market. One-time free download, no ads, no in-app purchases, no subscription, no
third-party analytics SDKs.

## What it does

Bronzla calculates how long someone can safely stay in the sun today, from three inputs: the
current UV index (from Apple WeatherKit), the user's Fitzpatrick skin phototype (I through VI,
set directly or derived from a seven-question in-app quiz), and the SPF of sunscreen they are
wearing. The result is a recommended session length, capped at 60% of the calculated time to one
minimal erythemal dose (MED) and never exceeding three hours in any case.

Supporting features: a session timer with flip and sunscreen-reapplication reminders and a live
Lock Screen countdown, hourly and ten-day UV forecasts, a tan tracker with session history and an
estimated vitamin D figure, and an Apple Watch app and widgets showing the current UV index and
remaining safe time.

Note: the app previously included a global leaderboard feature; it is not functional in the
current shipped build and is not advertised as a working feature on this site.

## The method, in brief

- UV index definition: 1 index unit = 25 mW/m² of erythemally weighted irradiance (WHO/WMO).
- Time to burn = MED (J/m²) / (uvIndex × 0.025) × sunscreen protection factor.
- Recommended session = 60% of time to burn, capped at 3 hours.
- Sunscreen protection factor = a flat 50% real-world efficiency discount applied to nominal SPF,
  reflecting under-application versus the ISO 24444 test dose.
- Vitamin D estimate plateaus at one MED and applies an unvalidated melanin multiplier by
  phototype; it is explicitly not a basis for supplementation decisions.

Full method, worked examples, the Fitzpatrick and MED tables, the unit-confusion warning
(erythemally weighted J/m² is not comparable to unweighted mJ/cm²), and the complete citation
list (WHO, ICNIRP, Fitzpatrick 1988, ISO 24444, Petersen & Wulf 2014, AAD, Holick 2011, Mayo
Clinic, Cleveland Clinic) are published at:

- English: https://bronzla.app/science/
- Turkish: https://bronzla.app/tr/bilim/

Bronzla is not a medical device and does not give medical advice. It carries a medical
disclaimer on every screen and page that gives exposure guidance.

## Privacy

No account, no server, no third-party analytics or advertising SDKs. Skin type, session history
and tan tracker photos stay in local storage on the user's device. Location is used only to
query Apple WeatherKit for the local UV index and is never linked to an identity; a manually
chosen city is also supported.

- Privacy: https://bronzla.app/privacy/ (Turkish: https://bronzla.app/tr/gizlilik/)
- Terms: https://bronzla.app/terms/ (Turkish: https://bronzla.app/tr/kosullar/)
